name: Jaehon Hwanghu
source:
All your life you lived to become the perfect Empress. But the Emperor says he doesn't need an empress that will merely help him. He instead chooses a runaway slave to be his mistress. And now, the mistress who has stolen your husband's heart has her eyes set on your throne.

[From in-app]
